audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads HARD while diffRating is 4/10, tone is the green #3ddc97 and report[14] calls it a favoured matchup at 53.21% over 265 games. The level chart is also inverted: win[] and phases[].side give Illaoi or Skill every row, contradicting the packet chart and the whys under them.
audit.why: whys[0]-[2] describe Gragas out-sustaining her slaps, whys[3] and [5] call it even, whys[4] gives Gragas the Cask window, whys[6] gives her the late field — exactly the packet chart Gragas/Gragas/Skill/Skill/Gragas/Skill/Illaoi.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN; chart set to Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Skill, Illaoi, flipped as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why gives a generic level-6 line and never states Gragas's actual spike against her: Explosive Cask displacing her off the cluster her ult needs.
audit.why: Leap of Faith spawns a Tentacle per champion hit and the tentacles swing from impassable terrain; Explosive Cask (100/85/70s) knocks enemies back from its impact point, so displacing her strands the freshly spawned field.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the Cask-vs-Leap-of-Faith displacement as the level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] ('Get E'd near a vessel') carries a description about burning a cooldown that has nothing to do with Test of Spirit.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range; the spirit echoes damage back to you and turns you into a Vessel if it dies or you walk away. That cooldown length is what makes dodging it the lane.
audit.corrected: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 — dodge it, or fight off her field.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames are false positives — 'Explosive Cask' and 'Test of Spirit' are the real Riot names in the kit files; the near-miss was against the lowercase forms.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Explosive Cask knocks her off her own tentacle cluster the instant she casts Leap of Faith, so the forest she spawns slaps empty air — bait the ult, then cask her.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 — dodge it, or fight off her field.

notes: No mirror audit existed for illaoi__gragas, so these findings are fresh. Level chart was inverted against the packet chart and against its own whys; flipped as one atomic group in both layers, including the two rows that keep their existing value so the group is complete. diff said HARD on a 53.21% lane whose own rating, tone and final line all read favoured — set to EVEN rather than guessing a stronger token; if the enum has a favoured value, that would be the better fit. Both packet suspectNames are false positives.
